title: Prime power extension induction
statement: For a property P of lifted-integer modules that contains zero objects, is invariant under isomorphism, and is closed under short exact extensions, if r is prime and P holds for the lifted module ZMod r, then P holds for the lifted module ZMod (r ^ e) for every natural number e.

proof.text: Induct on e. The zero exponent gives the zero module and hzero. The successor case is supplied by the named successor-step theorem.

lean.statement: theorem finite_torsion_prime_power_step (P : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ) → Prop) (hzero : ∀ A, IsZero A → P A) (hiso : ∀ {A B}, (A ≅ B) → P A → P B) (hext : ∀ (S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))), S.ShortExact → P S.X₁ → P S.X₃ → P S.X₂) (r e : ℕ) (hr : r.Prime) (hprime : P (ModuleCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ) (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))) : P (ModuleCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ) (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod (r ^ e))))
